source_excerpt: Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2', directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, continues its impressive theatrical run despite witnessing a decline in daily collections. The action drama, featuring Hrithik Roshan alongside Rajinikanth, collected Rs 5.90 cr net in India on its 15th day. According to Sacnilk, the film registered these earnings across 10,313 shows on Thursday, October 29.The latest figures represent an 18.1% drop from the previous day's domestic net collection of Rs 7.20 cr. Its cumulative India net earnings have now reached Rs 429.55 cr, while the domestic gross stands at Rs 502.65 cr. Overseas markets contributed Rs 2 cr on Thursday, taking the film's international gross to Rs 262.50 cr. Consequently, its worldwide gross collection has climbed to Rs 765.15 cr.Jailer 2 Movie Review'Jailer 2' language-wise box office collection on Day 15The Tamil version continued to lead the film's domestic performance, contributing Rs 3.20 cr from 4,462 shows. The Telugu version collected Rs 1.40 cr through 1,665 screenings. Meanwhile, the Hindi release added Rs 1.10 cr from 3,972 shows. The Kannada version contributed Rs 20 lakh through 214 screenings.In terms of occupancy, the Telugu version registered 19.1%, marginally ahead of Tamil's 18.1%. Kannada recorded 18%, while the Hindi version registered 9%.The Tamil 2D version reported 17.98% overall occupancy. Its morning, afternoon, evening and night shows recorded 14.62%, 17.54%, 18.77% and 21%, respectively. The Hindi 2D version registered 9.49% overall occupancy, with its respective show timings recording 6.33%, 9.17%, 9.92% and 12.33%. Meanwhile, the Telugu 2D version recorded 15.40% overall occupancy. Its morning shows registered 12.25%, followed by 16.58% in the afternoon, 15.08% in the evening and 15.58% at night.'Jailer 2' weekly and daily box office performanceThe film collected Rs 334.35 cr during its opening week. Its second-week domestic net earnings added another Rs 95.20 cr. The second Friday brought in Rs 14.50 cr, while Saturday witnessed an improvement with Rs 24.15 cr. Sunday emerged as the strongest day of the second weekend, contributing Rs 25.70 cr.The collections subsequently declined during the weekdays. Monday recorded Rs 9.45 cr, followed by Rs 8.30 cr on Tuesday. Andhra Pradesh and Telangana together contributed Rs 1.30 cr, while Karnataka added Rs 1.10 cr.Kerala recorded Rs 70 lakh, and the remaining Indian markets collectively contributed Rs 1.10 cr.How 'Jailer 2' outperforms Rajinikanth's 'Coolie'Rajinikanth's previous release, 'Coolie', had recorded considerably lower earnings at the same stage of its theatrical run. On its 15th day, the film collected Rs 2.40 cr net in India through 7,680 shows. The Tamil version contributed Rs 1.25 cr from 2,354 screenings. Hindi added Rs 60 lakh through 3,545 shows, while Telugu collected Rs 50 lakh from 1,625 screenings. The Kannada version earned Rs 5 lakh through 156 shows.'Coolie' eventually recorded Rs 271.50 cr in domestic net collections and Rs 317.23 cr in India gross earnings. Its overseas gross stood at Rs 176.25 cr, taking the worldwide total to Rs 493.48 cr. 'Coolie' had received mixed reviews.Meanwhile, 'Jailer 2' has recorded 479,990 admissions on its 15th day.
